intents.intent: Find a product design collaborator and possible cofounder to explore an accessible task-planning tool for volunteer teams, starting with a small prototype alongside our day jobs.
Meet an engineer who wants to turn small teams' confusing workflows into a clear, keyboard-friendly product; explore the problem together before deciding whether to become cofounders.
Find an early product team that needs paid user research to identify barriers in an accessibility-focused collaboration prototype.
Find a designer to make a private mobile journal easy to navigate without looking at the screen, as a modest weekend side project.
Find someone who can turn a collective's messy chore spreadsheet into a simple shared planner; I can build the data layer and want to explore a small, privacy-conscious experiment.
